rule_title: Provide care during a covered disruption
policy_instruction: Keep applicable care available during extraordinary circumstances.
evidence_quote: The service record states: Weather cancellation means no hotel, meals or transfer assistance. All EUR 152 care expenses were refused solely for weather.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts CARE-001: Keep applicable care available during extraordinary circumstances.
corrective_handling: Assess necessary care expenses separately from the compensation defence.

policy_instruction: Do not use touchdown as the arrival event.
evidence_quote: The rejection uses 15:55 touchdown and a 175-minute delay. The operations record confirms door opening with permission to leave at 16:08, a 188-minute delay.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts DEL-002: Do not use touchdown as the arrival event.
corrective_handling: Reassess arrival delay using door opening and the applicable compensation checks.

policy_instruction: Assess each issue under its own legal basis.
evidence_quote: The agent rejected both compensation and the documented EUR 18 meal solely because arrival delay was below three hours. No separate care assessment was made.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts INT-003: Assess each issue under its own legal basis.
corrective_handling: Assess the meal expense under care rules separately from fixed compensation.

policy_instruction: Use the final destination for a covered connecting journey.
evidence_quote: The refusal measures only the 70-minute Hamburg–Frankfurt delay, despite the protected single booking and five-hour delay at New York.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts EU-002: Use the final destination for a covered connecting journey.
corrective_handling: Assess the covered journey at its final destination.

policy_instruction: Complete Article 8 reimbursement within seven days of the valid refund choice.
evidence_quote: The refund choice was validly recorded on 2 October with verified payee and complete payment details. On 20 October the EUR 180 refund is still unpaid.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts REF-001: Complete Article 8 reimbursement within seven days of the valid refund choice.
corrective_handling: Record the missed deadline and escalate the outstanding refund without restarting its clock.

policy_instruction: Do not force a voucher.
evidence_quote: The service record marks the EUR 220 refund fulfilled by a voucher. The passenger selected money, never agreed to the voucher and has not redeemed it.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts REF-001: Do not force a voucher.
corrective_handling: Correct the refund route and verify the money refund; assess compensation separately.

policy_instruction: For involuntary denied boarding, arrange compensation immediately under Article 4(3).
evidence_quote: The boarding log confirms involuntary overbooking. The payment log records a deliberate 60-day compensation hold despite verified identity and complete payment details.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts DB-001: For involuntary denied boarding, arrange compensation immediately under Article 4(3).
corrective_handling: Arrange the required compensation assessment and payment promptly; review any reduction separately.

policy_instruction: Record voluntary benefits as an agreement.
evidence_quote: The signed EUR 300 voluntary surrender agreement was removed from the case and replaced with an involuntary boarding classification. No agreement entry remains in the handling record.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts DB-001: Record voluntary benefits as an agreement.
corrective_handling: Restore the voluntary agreement and assess the unpaid contractual benefit separately.

policy_instruction: Do not assume a document refusal is lawful without review.
evidence_quote: The agent issued a final refusal solely from DOCUMENT_INVALID without reviewing the conflicting authorization confirmation or obtaining validation records.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts DB-001: Do not assume a document refusal is lawful without review.
corrective_handling: Prepare specialist review of the conflicting documents and preserve the disputed facts.

policy_instruction: Use the affected flight price as the calculation basis.
evidence_quote: The stored calculation applies 75 percent to the entire EUR 2000 itinerary, including the unaffected EUR 400 segment, despite an available EUR 1600 affected-flight allocation.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts DOWN-001: Use the affected flight price as the calculation basis.
corrective_handling: Recalculate from the affected-flight eligible price and verify all required checks before proposing payment.

rule_title: Open a baggage incident and preserve deadlines
policy_instruction: If baggage is missing after 21 days, assess loss rights.
evidence_quote: On 24 October the agent refuses to assess loss rights for a bag due on 1 October and instructs the passenger to wait indefinitely.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts BAG-001: If baggage is missing after 21 days, assess loss rights.
corrective_handling: Assess loss rights now; request only missing valuation facts.

policy_instruction: Do not reject assistance only because notice is late.
evidence_quote: The assistance desk record confirms refusal solely because notice was 24 hours before departure. No reasonable efforts were attempted.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts PRM-001: Do not reject assistance only because notice is late.
corrective_handling: Refer the refused-carriage dispute to the trained specialist and investigate assistance provision.

rule_title: Handle injury, safety and discrimination allegations
policy_instruction: Send injury and death claims to the liability specialist.
evidence_quote: The agent classified the reported onboard burn injury as a routine meal expense, marked the EUR 240 bill as full settlement and closed the case without liability referral.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts SER-001: Send injury and death claims to the liability specialist.
corrective_handling: Preserve incident evidence and hand off the injury claim to the liability specialist.

policy_instruction: Do not hand over a case for missing evidence alone.
evidence_quote: The recorded sole handoff reason is missing receipt. No serious incident, authority limit, unsupported action or unresolved material conflict is cited.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts EVID-001: Do not hand over a case for missing evidence alone.
corrective_handling: Ask a clear question for the necessary missing evidence and reassess the same case.

rule_title: Hand over for a specific reason
policy_instruction: Do not hand over for anger alone.
evidence_quote: The recorded sole handoff reason is the phrase I am angry. No substantive escalation reason is recorded.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts ESC-001: Do not hand over for anger alone.
corrective_handling: Adapt tone; base any handoff on a concrete substantive reason rather than sentiment.

policy_instruction: Do not require receipts for fixed EU261 compensation.
evidence_quote: The agent makes a meal receipt a prerequisite for considering fixed arrival-delay compensation even though no expense is claimed.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts INT-003: Do not require receipts for fixed EU261 compensation.
corrective_handling: Remove the irrelevant receipt requirement and assess fixed compensation from the journey facts.

policy_instruction: Do not collect a card security code in case notes.
evidence_quote: The audit log confirms the agent requested a card security code by email and copied it into case notes. The sensitive value is omitted from this synthetic fixture.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts INT-002: Do not collect a card security code in case notes.
corrective_handling: Remove the unnecessary sensitive data through the authorized privacy process and use the approved identity and payment channel.

policy_instruction: Do not report a payment as complete until settlement is confirmed.
evidence_quote: The customer was told the refund was paid in full, while the authoritative synthetic ledger still shows submitted, not settled. No settlement confirmation exists.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts FIN-001: Do not report a payment as complete until settlement is confirmed.
corrective_handling: Correct the payment communication and keep the outstanding payment under a named owner.

rule_title: Track service targets without changing rights
policy_instruction: Do not reset target age after reassignment.
evidence_quote: The case was received on 10 October. Reassignment on 20 October replaced the service target origin with 20 October and erased ten days of backlog age.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts OPS-002: Do not reset target age after reassignment.
corrective_handling: Restore the original receipt time for service tracking and preserve separate legal deadlines.

policy_instruction: Reject stale actions after human takeover.
evidence_quote: The audit log records human takeover at version 4, followed by execution of an AI reply based on version 3 with no ownership or version check.
finding: The recorded synthetic handling contradicts OPS-003: Reject stale actions after human takeover.
corrective_handling: Reject the stale proposal and leave further case action with the current authorized owner.
